added.summary: `Switch`/`Match` choose the first case whose `when` holds, made again only when which case holds changes. `packClass(component, slot, variant?)` gives a slot's style-pack classes (an `@Component.slot.variant` token the UI resolves from the active pack, so a pack switch restyles it). `mount` and the event's `world` take the engine's `World`.

fixed.summary: Consecutive dynamic children (a `Show` beside a `Switch`) follow their changes instead of showing their first value only.
